json_schema.description: An owner_notify was injected into its recipient's stream successfully. This is the DELIVERY PREDICATE: notify_acked may only close a notification that has one of these, because a turn boundary proves the agent took a turn and proves nothing about whether it was ever told anything. Deliberately not the close itself — delivered and acknowledged are different facts, and collapsing them would make an undelivered notification indistinguishable from an unread one.
